sections.thesis: Treasuries had their biggest weekly sell-off in more than 18 months after a bigger than expected 0.4% rise in October consumer prices forced investors out of bond bets.

sentences.text: Treasuries had their biggest weekly sell-off in more than 18 months after a bigger than expected 0.4% rise in October consumer prices forced investors out of bond bets.
Ten-year yields rose 0.28 percentage points on the week to 5.14%, and two-year yields 0.33 points to 4.85%.
Markets fully price a quarter-point Fed rise next month.

sections.thesis: The Australian dollar fell to near 0.6775 in early Asian trading on Monday as the US dollar edged higher on hawkish comments from Fed officials.

sentences.text: The Australian dollar fell to near 0.6775 in early Asian trading on Monday as the US dollar edged higher on hawkish comments from Fed officials.
Sterling headed for a weekly loss of nearly 0.90% at around 1.3230 after US producer prices rose 6.5% from a year earlier.
Traders await Chinese industrial production and retail sales data on Monday.

sections.thesis: Tech stocks slumped on Friday as investors braced for further fallout from the crisis at Nvidia, with chip and data-center shares selling off.

sentences.text: Tech stocks slumped on Friday as investors braced for further fallout from the crisis at Nvidia, with chip and data-center shares selling off.
Nvidia closed down 2%, the Nasdaq fell 0.9% and the S&P 500 lost 0.4%.
Nvidia reports earnings on Tuesday, and Anthropic is expected to start trading on Thursday.

sections.thesis: Oil markets swung to surplus for the first time since the US-Iran war began, underpinned by a surge in Gulf shipments.

sentences.text: Oil markets swung to surplus for the first time since the US-Iran war began, underpinned by a surge in Gulf shipments.
Production outstripped consumption by almost 2mn barrels a day in October, and Brent settled at $95.84 a barrel on Friday.
Iran fired drones at Bahrain on Sunday, its second attack in three days, and its Guards said "The Strait of Hormuz is closed."
